summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held on 29 May 2026. The filing discloses that shareholders passed resolutions per ASX Listing Rule 3.13.2 and Section 251AA of the Corporations Act 2001. No specific terms, prices, or transaction details are provided, as the meeting appears to be a routine corporate governance matter. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a shareholder vote, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event. The filing is normal-course and lacks any special-situation catalyst.
